'''Fire Team Three''' was a daredevil burn-off brigade of [[Coruscant Rescue Ops/Legends|Coruscant Rescue Ops]]. They put out the flames on the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] when it crash-landed on the planet during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. Two workers died while attempting to douse the flames.
